verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.aws.amazon.com (HTTP 200) that describes itself as providing structured access to AWS service documentation for LLMs. Per-service llms.txt files also exist, such as the Resource Groups user guide, so an agent can be pointed at the root index or at service-level indexes. Missing for 10: evidence of markdown versions of doc pages (the .md probe returned 404), independent or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these files.
